label: thm.roabp
title: Shpilka–Volkovich hitting for low-width ROABPs with a low-degree monomial
difficulty_reason: The hitting property requires ruling out low-width ROABPs using block-diagonal monomial coefficient matrices and adjacent-block linear constraints derived from vanishing. Section8 builds a zero-block restriction argument, derivative-rank induction and full-rank Cauchy-matrix obstruction to obtain the width bound for arbitrary variable orders, which are substantive research-level obligations beyond routine qualification-exam rank calculations.
review_note: Selected Theorem1.9 exactly, with complete supporting Section8 width/rank characterization, homogeneous reduction, adjacent-block equations, zero-block restriction, partition-selection argument and full derivative/Cauchy proof through Claim8.9. Theorem1.10 is explicitly equivalent by complementation and is uncounted support. No conflation with646/Theorem1.8.
